summary: The proposed change introduces auto-detection for boolean arrays in contour plots, setting levels to [0.5] by default. This addresses the user's need for a simpler way to plot boolean 2D arrays.

issues.description: This change may introduce a behavioral regression risk by altering the default behavior of the contour function for non-boolean inputs. Users who rely on the default level settings for non-boolean data might experience unexpected results.
The code style could be improved by adding a comment explaining the new conditional check for boolean arrays.
